expects.query:
Using the `/vss-setup-behavior-analytics` skill, end-to-end and autonomously, deploy the `vss-behavior-analytics` service on this host so that **ROI ENTRY/EXIT events are triggered when an object's BOUNDING BOX overlaps a region of interest** — rather than only when the object's representative point falls inside the ROI polygon.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A bare Brev host with Docker + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY` for image pull. `vss-behavior-analytics` is **CPU-only** (`gpu_count: 0`; `ANY` pool). A live broker / perception input is NOT required — verify the **deploy-time configuration** only (a restart-looping container is fine). Bounding-box-overlap ROI detection is supported ONLY for image-based (2D image-plane) calibration, so: provide an image calibration that defines at least one ROI, choose an app entrypoint that actually emits ROI events, and set the ROI detection mode to bounding-box overlap.
checks: `docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-behavior-analytics` returns exit 0 (the exact `vss-behavior-analytics` container was created)

`docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' | grep -qE 'main_analytics_2d_app.py|main_analytics_3d_app.py|main_public_safety_app.py|main_search_and_alerts_app.py|main_composite_app.py'` returns exit 0 (an entrypoint that can emit ROI ENTRY/EXIT events is used)

`config_dest=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' | jq -r 'index("--config") as $i | if $i == null then empty else .[$i + 1] end'); config_src=$(docker inspect vss-behavior-analytics --format '{{json .Mounts}}' | jq -r --arg dest "$config_dest" '.[] | select(.Destination == $dest) | .Source' | head -1) && test -f "$config_src" && jq -e '([.app[] | select(.name == "sinkType") | .value] | last // "kafka") as $sink | (if $sink == "kafka" then .kafka.topics elif $sink == "redisStream" then .redisStream.streams elif $sink == "mqtt" then .mqtt.topics else [] end // []) as $destinations | ([.app[] | select(.name == "roiEventDetectionMode") | .value] | last) == "bbox" and (([.app[] | select(.name == "numWorkersForBehaviorCreation") | (.value | tonumber)] | last // 0) > 0) and any($destinations[]?; .name == "events" and ((.value // "") | length > 0))' "$config_src"` returns exit 0. This follows the exact container's active `--config` mount and proves bbox-overlap mode, an enabled behavior-creation processor, and an `events` destination in the active sink block; all three are required for SearchAndAlertsApp to emit ROI events.

A calibration defining at least one ROI is mounted (e.g. via `--calibration /resources/calibration.json`), and it is an IMAGE-based calibration — bbox-overlap mode is only honored for image calibration; on cartesian/geo the ROI check silently falls back to the coordinate-inside test (with a one-time warning), which would make the requested behavior a no-op.
